chunks: He said: 'This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of what you could not bear with patience.'

key_terms.تَأْوِيلٍ: Interpretation or explanation of the hidden meaning

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'ta'wil' in the story of Khidr and Musa?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse marks the pivotal transition from the apparent contradictions (zahir) of Khidr’s actions to their hidden wisdom (batin), illustrating the concept of ta'wil where divine knowledge transcends human limitation. It underscores the necessity of sabr (patience) not merely as endurance, but as the spiritual capacity to accept divine decrees before their rationale is fully revealed, a theme central to the Imams' teachings on the unseen.
